description: This file defines an abstract email service interface and a concrete SMTP implementation for sending plain text emails, primarily used for verification codes within an authentication system.

classes.name: EmailService
classes.description: Abstract interface for sending emails, defining the send_email method to be implemented by subclasses.

classes.name: SmtpEmailService
classes.description: Concrete implementation of EmailService that sends emails via SMTP, supporting features like TLS and custom reply-to headers.

methods.name: None send_email(self, to_email: str, subject: str, body: str, *, reply_to: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Sends a plain text email. In the abstract class, it raises NotImplementedError. In the SMTP implementation, it constructs and sends an email message via SMTP.

methods.name: EmailMessage _build_message(self, to_email: str, subject: str, body: str, reply_to: Optional[str])
methods.description: Constructs an EmailMessage object with the specified recipient, subject, body, and optional reply-to header.
